message: LONA data and order execution are healthy: a fixed-size sanity strategy made 459 trades and an ATR bracket sanity strategy made 169 trades on the same uploaded MT5 data. The six-factor permissive diagnostic also made 161 trades after fixing a Backtrader position-count bug. The remaining zero-trade stable-baseline result is a strategy-parity issue. Isolation tests identify the LONA Static/OrderBlock implementation at threshold 50 as the current blocker: with Static=0 and Dynamic=60 the strategy made 11 trades, while keeping Static=50 produced 0. Do not use the zero-trade LONA baseline as a performance verdict until factor parity is fixed.
